title: SIEM-ready Audit Export (beta) — Test Matrix (connectors, filters, reliability, soak/chaos)
content:
Overview / goals
- This is a working “sheet as text” test matrix for SIEM-ready audit export (beta).
- Focus: connector correctness + failure modes, filter correctness, delivery semantics (at-least-once), durability/retry/DLQ, high-volume soak, and chaos.
- Not a full QA plan for Console UI; covers API/worker/connector behavior + key UX-visible outcomes (status/health fields).

Environments / assumptions
- Staging cluster: hosted control plane + audit-export worker running with durable queue enabled (same config as prod but lower limits).
- Mock endpoints:
  - Splunk: mock HEC with controllable status codes + optional /services/collector/ack simulation.
  - Datadog: mock logs intake with controllable 202/4xx/5xx/429 behavior.
  - S3: localstack + real AWS dev bucket for IAM/KMS tests.
- Baseline event generator: emits Audit Event v1 examples (login, RBAC change, key rotation, export config change) with controllable rate and field variants.
- Delivery semantics: at-least-once. Duplicates acceptable; verify dedupe guidance is possible (event_id + emitted_at + destination_id / checkpoint markers).
- Key metrics to watch in every test:
  - export_delivery_latency_ms (p50/p95/p99)
  - export_success_total, export_failure_total (by sink + reason)
  - queue_backlog_depth (by destination)
  - dlq_write_total + dlq_depth
  - retry_attempts_total + retry_delay_seconds
  - circuit_breaker_open_total (if enabled)

Legend
- Priority: P0 must-pass for beta; P1 should-pass; P2 nice-to-have.
- Type: functional | negative | perf | chaos | security
- Status: todo | in_progress | blocked | done


TABLE (one row per test)
Columns: TestID | Priority | Area | Sink/Component | Type | Scenario | Steps (short) | Expected result | Evidence/metrics | Owner | Status | Notes

AEX-CONN-SPL-001 | P0 | Connector | Splunk HEC | functional | Happy path (no ACK) batch send | Configure Splunk dest (token, endpoint, index). Generate 1k events @ 50 eps. | Events received by HEC; 2xx; exporter marks delivered; backlog returns to 0. | success_total increments; latency stable; HEC received count == sent count (± duplicates allowed only if retries). | Leila Farouk | todo | Use mock server that logs request payloads.
AEX-CONN-SPL-002 | P0 | Connector | Splunk HEC | security | Auth failure (401) | Use invalid token; send test event. | Destination transitions to degraded; last_error includes auth classification; retries stop after short threshold (no storm). | failure_total{reason=auth}; circuit breaker opens (if present); no sustained QPS to HEC. | Benji Okafor | todo | Ensure UI-safe error message (no token leak).

AEX-CONN-SPL-004 | P0 | Connector | Splunk HEC | negative | Throttling (429) | Mock HEC returns 429 for 5 min; send steady 200 eps. | Backoff ramps; backlog grows; system remains stable; no unbounded memory growth; recovery drains after 429 stops. | queue_backlog_depth grows within bounds; retry_attempts_total increases; p99 latency degrades but recovers. | Sean Gallagher | todo | Validate backpressure controls ENG-13932.
AEX-CONN-SPL-005 | P1 | Connector | Splunk HEC | negative | Server errors (5xx burst) | Return 503 for 2 min in middle of run. | Retries with jitter; eventual success; duplicates possible but bounded. | failure_total{reason=5xx}; dedupe key works; backlog drains. | Leila Farouk | todo | Also validate alert triggers per SLO doc.
AEX-CONN-SPL-006 | P1 | Connector | Splunk HEC | functional | HEC ACK enabled (ackId flow) | Enable ACK; mock returns ackId + delayed ack confirmation. | Exporter waits for ACK before checkpoint; no premature success. | delivered checkpoints lag until ACK; latency increases but accurate; no lost events. | Kevin Osei | todo | Align with ADR-0218.
AEX-CONN-SPL-007 | P1 | Connector | Splunk HEC | negative | ACK never arrives | Enable ACK; mock returns ackId but /ack never confirms. | Retries ACK polling; eventually fails batch -> DLQ or error state depending on policy; doesn’t checkpoint. | dlq_write_total increments or destination degraded; no silent drop. | Kevin Osei | todo | Clarify expected behavior w/ platform.
AEX-CONN-SPL-008 | P0 | Connector | Splunk HEC | negative | Partial batch failure (mixed 2xx/4xx) | Simulate event-level parse errors (Splunk rejects some payloads). | Failed events are DLQ’d with reason=schema/too_large; successful events checkpoint. | dlq_write_total{reason=schema}; success_total increments for accepted subset. | Benji Okafor | todo | If Splunk only returns per-request status, treat as whole batch fail.
AEX-CONN-SPL-009 | P1 | Connector | Splunk HEC | negative | Payload too large | Generate events near max size; force > limit. | Exporter splits batch or DLQs oversized single event; no infinite retry. | failure_total{reason=payload_too_large}; dlq contains event_id(s). | Leila Farouk | todo | Need exact size limit in implementation.
AEX-CONN-SPL-010 | P2 | Connector | Splunk HEC | perf | Batch size tuning (latency vs throughput) | Sweep batch_size: 100/500/2000; constant eps. | Identify safe default; no timeouts; stable CPU/mem. | latency histos + success rate; connector request duration. | Aisha Bello | todo | Produces guidance for docs later.

AEX-CONN-DD-005 | P1 | Connector | Datadog Logs | negative | 5xx intermittent | Inject 500s at 10% rate for 15 min. | Retries; success continues; duplicates possible but bounded. | success rate > 99% (excluding 5xx windows); retry_attempts_total. | Leila Farouk | todo | Use for alert tuning.
AEX-CONN-DD-006 | P2 | Connector | Datadog Logs | negative | Payload format rejection (400) | Send event with invalid JSON / forbidden field (simulate bug). | Fail fast; DLQ with reason=schema; surface schema error to operator. | dlq_write_total{reason=schema}; last_error includes sample event_id only (no PII). | Benji Okafor | todo | Useful for regression tests.

AEX-WRK-003 | P1 | Worker/Queue | Retry policy | negative | Exponential backoff + jitter | Trigger consistent 503s; observe retry intervals. | Intervals grow with cap; jitter present; avoids synchronization. | retry_delay_seconds distribution. | Sean Gallagher | todo | Helps prevent retry storms.

Open questions / gaps (keep updated)
- Do we auto-pause destinations on persistent auth failures (401/403) to prevent storms? If yes, add explicit tests for pause/resume behavior + operator override.
- DLQ format: what fields are stored, retention, and how to avoid storing sensitive request context.
- Dedup guidance: confirm canonical dedupe key (event_id) is always present and stable across retries + sinks.
- Splunk partial failure semantics: do we ever get per-event errors from HEC in our current implementation? If not, treat as whole-batch.
- “Default filters” product decision: export all vs export only security/admin events by default.

Quick TODO (next 1–2 weeks)
- Build/borrow mock HEC + mock Datadog server harness with deterministic failure scripts.
- Add a simple “coverage checker” script: compares generated event_ids vs received event_ids (per sink).
- Write 3 canonical load profiles for soak tests (steady, burst, chaos).
- Identify minimum must-pass set for beta go/no-go: SPL-001/002/004, DD-001/002/003, S3-001/002/003/005, FLT-001/003/005, WRK-001/002/004, CP-001/002, SOAK-001, CHAOS-001.
